page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.g7 server family. It is powered by the KVM hypervisor and runs on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration features dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance provides 128 physical cores and 128 vCPUs, maintaining a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers.

With its high-density dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, the ecs.g7.32xlarge offers a resource-dense profile for large-scale enterprise applications. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs makes it a cost-efficient option for workloads that rely heavily on centralized network storage and pure CPU compute power. This instance is suited for enterprise applications, web serving, large-scale databases, and general-purpose workloads requiring high core counts and substantial memory capacity.
